method: Enumerate corners, edge stationary points and interior stationary points of the exact two-joint planar endpoint-height function. Optimize both distal capsule endpoints over the continuous commanded joint rectangle. Sample torso orientation at one-degree intervals, at the minimum nonpenetrating box height. Separately evaluate recorded virtual torso projections at their actual requested height.
qualification_economy: New observable: continuous-joint distal reach under torso-floor clearance, distinguished from finite grid misses and bend restrictions. Reuses RigidTree, SDK compilation, source/runtime bindings, contained stages, operation mutex and retained-file inventory. No native gate or historical evaluator is duplicated.
selection_provenance: The sixteen inherited bodies and fourteen-world route are exposed posthoc inputs. All bounded descriptor corners and 256 deterministic generated descriptors form a geometric screen, not held-out physical evaluation.
limits: Continuous joint minimization applies only to the validated planar positive-z two-joint topology and the unchanged normalized command range [-0.9,0.9]. Floating-point calculations use an explicit numerical band.
Orientation and body populations remain sampled. No continuous orientation or morphology coverage is claimed.
Root height is a hypothetical geometric convention. No native world is constructed, moved, reset or stepped.

A positive minimum clearance excludes distal floor contact at that sampled orientation with a nonpenetrating torso; it does not exclude upper-link contact, momentum-driven motion, contact switching or recovery.
A nonpositive minimum is only a necessary reach condition. Other-body collisions, self-collision, support forces, friction, momentum, joint speed and work are not solved.
Initially selected limbs reproduce positive hip leverage used by the exposed controller. Hip leverage does not certify the direction or magnitude of actual contact torque.
Retained projection diagnosis is posthoc and does not change native eligibility, selection or consumed campaign evidence.
No training, Tier 2, Tier 3, recovery qualification, real-time, physical acceptance or release authority.
